evidence.note: Abandon pm-248 as a plan, not as an accept. Seasons and the torn-sheet 404 were verified live at 1366x768 and 390x844 (probe-seasons 28/28, probe-lost 34/34), and the code for Ask the Ink's model tier is on main (npm test 1909 pass at 303eaa3, fake-model probe 53/53). The only failing outcome is production reach: GET/POST /api/ask are 404 and 0 of 17 deployed chunks carry api/ask. The causes are a stale Vercel deploy (esc-384) and ASK_LLM plus ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset (esc-383). Both need the account owner, and they are cost and external-account decisions. A replan would add no code, because the product owner cannot set a key or redeploy. It would also duplicate pm-255, which already holds the remaining Ask work: t-1557 deploy-bundle probe and t-1558 tier probe, queued after_plan pm-248. Abandoning frees pm-255 to run. This is not an accept: the Ask production outcome stays unmet until a person sets the env, redeploys, and a later acceptance sees GET /api/ask return 200 with enabled:true. The plan can be reopened with plan_manager_reopen_plan.
